name: Kente Strip-Weave
desc: Ashanti kente cloth built from narrow vertical strips, each alternating warp-stripe babadua bands with weft-float blocks of inlaid diamonds, combs and hollow squares, adjacent strips staggered so the blocks march in a bold gold-red-green-black checker as the cloth scrolls under a warm sheen.

style.doc: palette: royal gold / muted Ewe / maximal primaries / tonal monochrome relief / indigo ceremonial
